SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
WEDNESDAY - MARCH 26, 2025 - 07:00 P.M.
MAIN THEATER - CERRITOS CENTER FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS
18000 PARK PLAZA DRIVE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.gov and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made during regular business hours by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248.
Order of Agenda
The City Council, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Main Theater at the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or in writing as described below. Public comments are limited to items listed on this special meeting agenda only.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk at 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703 no later than 10:00 a.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 10:00 a.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting and the document(s) will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 or at city_clerk@cerritos.us in advance of the meeting to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE SUCCESSOR
AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD WEDNESDAY, MARCH 26, 2025,
7:00 PM, IN THE MAIN THEATER AT THE CERRITOS CENTER FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS,
18000 PARK PLAZA DRIVE, CERRITOS, CA 90703.

  1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

  REORDERING OF THE AGENDA
  At this juncture, the City Council, by consensus, reordered the agenda to install the newly
  elected Councilmembers (Item 2) after the Pledge of Allegiance/National Anthem (Item 4).

  2.  Installation of newly elected Councilmembers

  Ernie Nishii, President, ABC Unified School District Board of Education, and Toan Nguyen,
  Deputy Superintendent and Chief Financial Officer, ABC Unified School District,
  administered the Oath of Office to newly elected Council/Agency Member Sophia M. Tse.

  John Wu, Mayor, City of San Gabriel, administered the Oath of Office to newly elected
  Council/Agency Member Jennifer Hong.

  Rob Bonta, Attorney General, State of California, administered the Oath of Office to newly
  elected Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido.

  3.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Father John C. Cordero, Holy Family Catholic Church.

  4.  Pledge of Allegiance/National Anthem

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Maddox Yokoyama and family members.

  The National Anthem was sung by Elisha Heartlyn Tuazon, Cerritos High School student.

  5.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jennifer Hong
  Council/Agency Member Lynda P. Johnson
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Council/Agency Member Sophia M. Tse
  Council/Agency Member Frank Aurelio Yokoyama

  6.  Annual Mayoral Transition (Selection of Mayor and Mayor Pro Tem)

  Cynthia Nava, City Clerk, declared the office of Mayor/Chair vacant and called for nominations
  for the office of Mayor/Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Pulido nominated Council/Agency Member Yokoyama for the office of
  Mayor/Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, the City Clerk declared nominations closed.

6.  Annual Mayoral Transition (Selection of Mayor and Mayor Pro Tem) (continued)

  MOTION: As nominated by Council/Agency Member Pulido, and seconded by Council/Agency
  Member Johnson, Council/Agency Member Yokoyama was presented for consideration as
  Mayor/Chair (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hong, Johnson, Pulido, Tse, Yokoyama
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  The City Clerk declared Council/Agency Member Yokoyama as Mayor/Chair.

  Mayor Yokoyama declared the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair vacant and called for
  nominations for the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Pulido nominated Council/Agency Member Johnson for the office of
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, Mayor Yokoyama declared nominations closed.

  MOTION: As nominated by Council/Agency Member Pulido, and seconded by Council/Agency
  Member Tse, Council/Agency Member Johnson was presented for consideration as Mayor Pro
  Tem/Vice Chair (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The nomination carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hong, Johnson, Pulido, Tse, Yokoyama
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  The City Clerk declared Council/Agency Member Johnson as Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

7.  Public Comments

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  A number of additional individuals and groups offered congratulations to the newly
  elected City Council, and the newly selected Mayor Pro Tem and newly selected Mayor.

  Seeing no further speakers, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

8.  Closing Comments (Mayor, Mayor Pro Tem, and Councilmembers)

  Comments were made by Councilmembers Hong, Tse, and Pulido, Mayor Pro Tem
  Johnson, and Mayor Yokoyama.

  Mayor Yokoyama invited the community to a reception at the Sierra Room.
